node.title: Mersenne common-factor weighted-degree bound
node.closure: the full gcd has weighted degree at most 217
node.statement: At Mersenne full-lift support e=130237, let P be the primitive full gcd of the weight-(1,5,5), degree-264 interpolation kernel. Since the kernel has dimension at least 938 and division by P embeds it into weighted degree at most 264-wdeg(P), while M(46)=935<938<=990=M(47), one has wdeg(P)<=217 and deg_(Y,Z)(P)<=43. In the higher-degree branch d>=2, cofactor Bezout captures at least 7583-(52-2)^2=5083 selected polynomial pairs on P. Their size-807 inside cores force at least 126266 factor points, leaving at most 3971 inside exceptions.
